products.title: Noise · Buds R1 — True Wireless Earbuds
products.descriptionHtml:
Noise Buds R1 brings a considered approach to daily wireless listening. Review the specifications below to check compatibility and fit for your setup.

Key Features

  • Design: 11 mm drivers
  • Performance: Four microphones with environmental noise cancellation for voice calls
  • Everyday use: Bluetooth 5.3

Specifications

  • Colour: Matte Black
  • Up to 40 hours total playback including case
  • IPX5 water resistance

In the Box: Contents must be confirmed against the physical retail pack before publication.

Supplier-provided specifications are pending sample verification.

Before ordering: compatibility and returns

Need a device compatibility check? WhatsApp +91 84520 26751 with your device model. Estimated dispatch: 3–5 business days after verified payment, subject to availability. Shipping details.

Report arrival issues promptly. For orders below ₹1,000, photos generally suffice; at ₹1,000 or more, a continuous unboxing video is requested by the fulfilment partner. Legal consumer rights remain unaffected if you cannot supply a video. Read Returns, Refunds & Replacements.

products.title: JBL · Endurance Race — Sports True Wireless Earbuds (Black)
products.descriptionHtml:
JBL Endurance Race true wireless sports earbuds — Black, manufacturer/supplier reference JBLENDURACEBLK.

Key features

  • JBL Pure Bass with 6 mm dynamic drivers
  • Up to 30 hours of total listening time with charging case under manufacturer test conditions
  • Secure TwistLock fit; IP67 dust and water resistance
  • Bluetooth 5.2, Ambient Aware and TalkThru

In the box: Earbuds, charging case, USB-C charging cable, quick-start and safety literature, enhancers and three sizes of eartips per supplier listing. Product images show the original Endurance Race model, not Endurance Race 2.

Availability is subject to confirmation.
